readme.excerpt: Full-stack observability. Every metric, every second. Metrics · Logs · Traces · Flows · Topology Infrastructure · APM · NPM · DBM · RUM · Synthetics · Cloud · AI OpenTelemetry · SNMP · NetFlow/IPFIX/sFlow · IPMI · Redfish · 800+ integrations Visit our Home Page MENU: WHO WE ARE KEY FEATURES GETTING STARTED HOW IT WORKS FAQ DOCS COMMUNITY CONTRIBUTE LICENSE [!WARNING] People get addicted to Netdata. Once you use it on your systems, there's no going back. --- WHO WE ARE Netdata is a full-stack observability platform: infrastructure, application performance monitoring (OpenTelemetry traces, service maps, RED), digital experience (real user monitoring, synthetic monitoring), network performance monitoring (SNMP, topology, NetFlow/IPFIX/sFlow, traps, BGP), databases, logs (monitoring and management) and cloud, with AI troubleshooting over all of it. Netdata is distributed and real-time. Netdata Agents collect, store and analyze data where it is generated, per second, with machine learning anomaly detection on every metric. Netdata Parents and Netdata Cloud combine them into one view, without centralizing the data. Netdata scales to 100,000+ nodes, and its Agent is open source. Netdata Design: Understanding over traffic lights – Monitoring tells you that something is wrong; observability tells you why. Netdata gives you both, from the same data. Everything, every second, affordably –
